headline: Social Media Content Creator
summary: Fresh graduate and content creator who has built a following for local food and travel content on Guimaras. I shoot and edit short videos, design posts in Canva and know what makes island audiences stop scrolling. I am looking for my first role on a brand's social media team.
skills: Short-form content and social media trends

experience.title: Content Creator
bullets: Create short videos on Guimaras mangoes, beaches and eateries for pages with about 18,000 followers.
Worked with four local resorts and cafés on paid posts in exchange for fees or stays.

experience.title: Communications Intern
bullets: Photographed and wrote captions for the Manggahan Festival coverage.

projects.name: Island eats video series
projects.description: A 20-episode TikTok series featuring family-run eateries, with the most-watched episode reaching 250,000 views.
